_notes: Advisor-shaped summary for `deal-advisor` discovery; the full underwriting config is inputs.json. irr and cashflow_monthly are computed by src.core.finance from inputs.json; price_per_sqft = purchase_price / 1936 sqft (listing.txt). market_ppsf is set equal to price_per_sqft -- i.e. 'priced at market' -- because no comp data ships with this repo; supply a real comp to make the advisor's ppsf signal meaningful. area_safety_index is omitted and defaults to 0.5 (neutral).
